instruction.name: xvreplgr2vr.b
instruction.description: Broadcast the low 8 bits of `val` to all lanes of `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move
experiments.notes: xvreplgr2vr.b latency from a round trip through xvpickve2gr.w; the pick contributes 6 cycles.

latencies.notes: xvreplgr2vr.b latency from a round trip through xvpickve2gr.w; the pick contributes 6 cycles.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r9; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r10; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r9; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r10; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.01 cycles. Counter 0xfa normalised per instruction. The measured CPI 1.0012 is the nominal 1 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: xvreplgr2vr.b latency is 2 cycle(s), measured as a round trip through xvpickve2gr.w.
